fieldValues.title: Received reports leave no trace: 36 of 37 received, 0 records derived from any
fieldValues.summary: Every run-report but one has been received, at 4 to 8 seconds each; receipt is wired only to the pause rule. No finding, decision, exercise or comment derives from any report, the 8 measurement results all wait on an evaluator the owner has never given, and the same section-7 lessons recur across reports with no record.
evidence: srs-programme relations over the 37 stewardship/run-report records, 2026-11-03: 36 receives, 0 inbound derived-from or evidences
clerk: receives is read by upkeep.mjs (pause), desk.mjs, agenda.mjs, guard.mjs only; wg-analyst reads section 6 for "Queue running dry" only
TPR reports 11-01 and 11-02: "the I1 window opens at the cycle close, so a close-time read is always empty", twice, no issue
session 9f84b90c, 2026-11-02: seven reports received between 11:40:08 and 11:40:42
fieldValues.body: The throttle works as designed and is the only thing receipt does. The handbook's Measurement and retrospective section (rate each indicator; close each period with a retrospective decision; check revisit_when) has never been exercised. Candidate remedies, all on existing machinery: the steward writes a finding derived-from the reports when a section-7 lesson recurs; receipt shows section 7 and asks one question (noted, finding, rate the indicator); one retrospective session per period over the reports' section 7 and the pending evaluators.
